title: APPEAL/1/2026 — GANPAT RAM vs. RAJASTHAN GRAMIN BANK
text:
Court of the Presiding Officer
Debts Recovery Tribunal, Jaipur
Item No. 7
Case No. APPEAL/1/2026 IN OA/259/2023
GANPAT RAM Vs RAJASTHAN GRAMIN BANK
Date: 16.01.2026.
Proceedings through hybrid mode
Present:
Shri Sanjay Kumar Shukla, Counsel for the Applicant
Shri Raj Kumar, Counsel for the Respondent Bank/FI
This is fresh appeal filed by the appellant. Appellant requests
for issuance of notices.
Issue notices to the respondents. Counsel appears for the
Respondent No. 1 and accepts the notices, paper book be supplied
to the counsel. Issue notices to the auction purchaser by DASTI
as well as speed post AD along with complete paper book and to be
served by the applicant. Notice to be collected by the applicants
Reply be filed by the respondent Bank before the next date of
hearing.
After the reply is filed the appellant may file rejoinder to avert
the facts narrated in the Reply.
List the matter for completion of pleadings on 26.03.2026
before Registrar, status quo be maintained by all the parties.
(Vimal Gupta)
Presiding Officer
Debts Recovery Tribunal, Jaipur
